newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgutneftegaz ADR to start January 13.
newsitem.headline: Surgutneftegaz ADR to start January 13.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in AO Surgutneftegaz will be launched on January 13, the company's financial adviser said on Friday.
Maxim Gresko, chief executive of Konvest, told Reuters that custodian ING Bank Eurasia had just opened a special account for depositary Bank of New York in Surgutneftegaz's register.
"This was the last technical formality," he said.
Surgutneftegaz has risen strongly in recent days amid a general rally of leading shares on expectations of the ADR issue.
One level-one ADR will cover 50 underlying ordinary shares.
At 1335 GMT Surgutneftegaz was $0.605, off an earlier $0.645 high but above Thursday's closing $0.575.
The ADRs were quoted on an when/issued basis in London at $31-$32.
Surgutneftegaz preference shares were $0.421, after closing at $0.379. The company has said it also plans to issue ADRs on its preference shares.
